covered_dimensions: Actual ordinary compositions of one E have different historical P IDs and centroids; pinned canonical atoms determine the same new reference P when either or both source forms are supplied; emitted roles are neutral and no occurrences are produced.
Different role metadata and carrier splits normalize to the same ordered child-ID run and one ordinary composition operand.
Missing canonical atom proofs produce a sorted E frontier and zero executable/root buffers; batched retry with pinned atoms completes and verifies every result.

Authenticated non-atom singleton [E] supplies a transparent physicality, produces an explicit missing E without independent closure, and agrees with an authenticated noncollapsed form without creating a content cycle.
A later alternate form with an altered full witness, body geometry or trajectory fingerprint rejects the whole plan without publishing partial execution.
Pinned atom complete witness, centroid, tier and geometry epoch must agree with native codepoint identity and authenticated atomic physicality.
Nested canonical content and repeated requested roots share one calculation per composite E, preserve exact root mappings and enforce depth even through previously visited nodes.
Root, carrier, logical, node and peak memory envelopes produce explicit finite refusals.
A calculated result retaining the exact E but corrupting the complete witness tail is rejected; truncated result arrays also reject.
Pinned atom roots map directly to shared known tuples and empty input has an explicit complete zero-request plan.
Overflowing carrier envelope rejects before carrier-body hashing or traversal, using a one-carrier payload as the deliberate overclaim control.
A 65,536-child run remains one canonical planner operand and is realized by the existing ordinary composer with native carrier packing and exact full identity.
An actually compiled mutant omitting complete calculated-witness comparison is detected with the exact E unchanged.
An actually compiled mutant omitting each source physicality/body/carrier validation is detected by corrupt alternate forms.
An actually compiled mutant treating transparent singleton [E] as canonical child topology is detected by the valid alternate representation control.
